english.title: Driver of London hackney carriage suffer other person to act as driver without proprietor's consent
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a driver authorized by a proprietor to act as driver of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), suffered another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to act as driver of that hackney carriage without the consent of the proprietor thereof
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
